name: Pencil Hire
author: pencilwp

sections.description:
Pencil Hire is a lightweight job listing and recruitment plugin for companies, startups, agencies, and SaaS teams that want to hire inside WordPress.

Publish jobs, build a public career board, and manage applications with CV uploads — without leaving your WordPress dashboard.

Whether you need a simple careers page or a full hiring workflow, Pencil Hire gives you a clean, modern foundation that works with the shortcode, Gutenberg block, or Elementor.

Pencil Hire Pro
This is the free (Lite) version of Pencil Hire. Upgrade to Pencil Hire Pro for an advanced hiring workflow, drag-and-drop apply form builder, candidate notes & ratings, richer job pages, custom emails, export tools, and premium support.

Free Features

Everything you need to launch a professional careers page:

  • Job listings — Dedicated Jobs post type with featured image support
  • Rich job content — Display title, salary range, description, responsibilities, requirements, skills, and benefits
  • Job taxonomies — Category, Type, Level, Location, and Experience
  • Public job board — [pencilhire-lite] shortcode with optional job limit
  • Live frontend filters — Filter by Category, Type, and Location (AJAX)
  • Single job pages — Clean detail templates with Apply flow
  • Application form — Collect name, contact details, answers, and CV/resume upload
  • Private CV storage — CVs saved in a protected uploads folder (admin-only download)
  • Applications inbox — View, download CV, delete, and manage submissions in admin
  • Application statuses — Pending, Reviewed, Shortlisted, and Rejected
  • Email notifications — Alert recruiters and send candidate confirmation emails
  • Settings page — Company name, recruiter email, brand colors, listing page, filter toggle
  • Setup wizard — Guided first-run configuration
  • Welcome dashboard — Getting started tabs, dummy job data, and quick reference
  • Dummy job generator — Create sample jobs to preview listings and design layouts
  • Gutenberg block — “Pencil Hire Jobs” block for pages, posts, and widgets
  • Elementor widget — Optional “Pencil Hire Jobs” widget (requires Elementor)
  • Auto Job List page — Created on activation with the shortcode embedded
  • Privacy tools — Personal data export/erase callbacks for applicant emails
  • Translation ready — Full text domain support for localization

Pencil Hire Pro Features

Need a stronger hiring workflow? Pencil Hire Pro unlocks professional recruitment tools:

  • Advanced hiring workflow — Shortlist, reject, and select candidates with a clearer pipeline
  • Drag-and-drop application form builder — Customize apply forms without code
  • Candidate notes & activity log — Keep internal notes and track hiring activity
  • Candidate ratings — Score applicants while you review
  • Richer job single pages — Add image and video to job detail pages
  • Advanced career page options — More control over how your board looks and behaves
  • Custom email templates — Brand recruiter and candidate emails
  • Export tools — Export applications for sharing or offline review
  • Premium support — Priority help when you need it
  • 1 year of updates — Stay current with new Pro improvements

Who Is Pencil Hire For?

  • Companies building an in-house careers page
  • Agencies managing hiring sites for clients
  • Startups that want applications and CVs in WordPress
  • Teams that prefer shortcode, Gutenberg, or Elementor workflows

Privacy

Pencil Hire collects applicant personal data when someone submits a job application: name, email, phone, address, application answers, optional portfolio link, salary expectation, start date, and a CV/resume file.

  • Application records are stored in a custom database table on your site.
  • CV files are stored in a private uploads folder (uploads/pencilhire-cvs/) that is blocked from direct public web access.
  • Only WordPress administrators can view applications and download CVs from the admin area.
  • Deleting an application also deletes its CV file. Uninstalling the plugin removes the applications table and private CV folder.
  • The plugin registers WordPress personal data export and erase callbacks for applicant email addresses.

Site owners are responsible for publishing a privacy policy that covers recruitment data retention and applicant rights.

Third-party services

This plugin does not connect to external job boards or third-party APIs by default.
Optional Elementor integration uses the Elementor plugin if it is installed:
https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/

Usage

Job Listing Shortcode

[pencilhire-lite]

Optional attributes:

[pencilhire-lite limit=”6″]

[pencilhire-lite filters=”yes”]

[pencilhire-lite filters=”no”]

Gutenberg Block

  1. Edit a page, post, or widget area.
  2. Add block → search for Pencil Hire Jobs.
  3. Set Job Count and Show Filters in the sidebar.
  4. Publish.

Elementor Widget

  1. Edit a page with Elementor.
  2. Search for Pencil Hire Jobs in the widgets panel.
  3. Drag it into your layout and set Job Count.
  4. Publish the page.

Job Apply System

Each job includes an Apply button. Example URL format:

/?pencilhire_lite_apply=1&job_id=123

Job Post Type

  • Post Type slug: pencilhire-lite
  • Label: Jobs
  • Public: Yes
  • Supports: Title, Featured Image
  • Job content is stored in custom metabox fields (not the default post editor)

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pencilhire-lite directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Complete the optional setup wizard (or skip and configure later under Jobs → Settings).
  4. Create jobs from the Jobs menu in admin.
  5. Display jobs with the shortcode [pencilhire-lite], the Gutenberg block, or the Elementor widget.
  6. If job URLs 404, visit Settings → Permalinks and click Save Changes once.
sections.faq:
Is Pencil Hire free?

Yes. Pencil Hire Lite is free forever and includes job listings, applications with CV upload, filters, emails, settings, Gutenberg block, and optional Elementor support. A Pro version is available for advanced hiring tools.

Does Pencil Hire require WooCommerce?

No. Pencil Hire works independently.

Does it require Elementor?

No. Elementor is optional. The shortcode and Gutenberg block work without Elementor.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

Free covers creating jobs, publishing a job board, collecting applications with CVs, statuses, emails, and basic settings. Pro adds an advanced hiring workflow, form builder, notes/activity/ratings, richer job pages, custom emails, export tools, and premium support.

Can I customize the contact email on the job page?

Yes. Use the pencilhire_lite_contact_email filter, or configure the recruiter email under Jobs → Settings.

Are CV uploads public?

No. New CV uploads are stored in a private folder and can only be downloaded by administrators through the WordPress admin.

Is it SEO friendly?

Yes. Jobs are a public custom post type and can be indexed like normal WordPress content.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Hardened application form (honeypot, URL validation, field length limits)
  • Fixed applications list N+1 job title queries and added pagination
  • Added database indexes for status/created_at
  • Capped job listing limits across shortcode, AJAX, block, and Elementor
  • Hardened email headers and uninstall cleanup
  • Contact email on job pages now uses Settings recruiter email

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Pencil Hire
  • Custom job post type with taxonomies and job meta fields
  • Job listing shortcode with live filters
  • Gutenberg block and optional Elementor widget
  • Application form with private CV upload
  • Admin applications inbox with status management
  • Admin + candidate email notifications
  • Setup wizard, Settings page, and Welcome dashboard
  • Dummy job data generator
  • Privacy export/erase support
